limitations: Phase 6 verifies release-policy, campaign and export contracts with fixtures; no live Flickr reviewers or occurrence publication were exercised.
A passing software gate does not establish that human labels, coordinates, dates or taxonomic judgments are scientifically correct.
Campaign inclusion probabilities are preserved but this phase does not estimate population metrics from the queues.
No measured accuracy, reviewer throughput, cost or operational-savings improvement is claimed.

regression_fix.outcome: SQLite state-store contexts now commit or roll back before deterministic close; this removed a reproducible Python 3.14 full-suite ResourceWarning.

tasks.outcome: Final eligibility requires decisive source-hash-bound review plus duplicate, identity, domain, life-stage, spatiotemporal, adjudication and release-policy evidence.
Unreviewed candidates retain route, embedding, ranking, margin and priority evidence but remain explicitly excluded.
Four Polars/Parquet campaigns preserve inclusion probability, strata, grouping fields, score bands and competitors.
The complete batch is rejected before write when any record is unverified, conflicted, stale, unsupported or ineligible.
